snippet.title: ROM Game Trailer
snippet.description:
https://bincurlgames.itch.io/rom

ROM is a short experimental experience. Explore a desolate island, revive it's forgotten machines and take control of the game's atmosphere.

This Game was developed as part of the Game Design bachelor-program at HTW Berlin, special thanks to our professors and coaches:
Prof. Susanne Brandhorst, Prof. Thomas Bremer, Sven Gorholt

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/bincurlgames
